content: LINDON LINDON D uring the Second Age of Middle-earth, the greatest kingdom of the Elves is that of Lindon to the west of the Blue Mountains. It is here where the High Elves dwell, and are ruled over by Gil-galad, the High King of the Noldor. The Elves have ever been the enemies of darkness and have long fought to rid the world of the shadow of Morgoth, and in the later Ages, that of his servant, Sauron. Following the forging of the Rings of Power and Sauron’s rise in the latter years of the Second Age, Gil-galad knew it was only a matter of time before war came to the Elves. Using the power of the Ring, Sauron crushed many of the kingdoms of the Elves, leaving a trail of ruined cities and broken bodies in his wake. When Elendil, the High King of Gondor and Arnor, came to Gil-galad with the proposition of forging an alliance to challenge the rule of Sauron, it was one that Gil-galad accepted readily and such an alliance may yet prove to be the downfall of the Dark Lord. Within Lindon lies the Grey Havens, the Elven port which sees the ships sail to the Undying Lands, and it is here where the Elf lord Círdan dwells, overseeing the Elven ships that set sail from the port itself. Though he is well past his prime in terms of fighting, Círdan is still more than adept with the ways of magic, able to use his powers to aid his allies. When the Elves of Lindon are called to war, Círdan will gather his kin from the Grey Havens and march with them to aid the High King of the Noldor. At the height of their power, the armies of Lindon are without peer within the free peoples of Middle-earth. The Elves that make up their ranks are accomplished warriors with blade, bow and spear, and each of them has seen countless battles over their immortal lives. Clad in gleaming golden armour, the sight of the armies of the High Elves is one that will make even the bravest Orc tremble, such is the renowned martial prowess of the Elves.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: RIVENDELL RIVENDELL O ver the years of the Third Age, the power of the Elves has begun to wane. Many of the Elves either perished in the War of the Last Alliance or have sailed west to the Undying Lands, sensing their time in Middle- earth is drawing to a close. Though their power is greatly diminished compared to that of the earlier Ages, the High Elves are still a formidable fighting force and one that can hold their own against almost any foe. In the closing years of the Third Age, much of the remaining power of the High Elves resides within the great Elven hall of Rivendell. A place of peace and tranquillity, Rivendell is ruled over by the Lord Elrond, the former ward of Gil-galad, and is protected by Vilya, one of the three Elven Rings. Under Elrond’s rule, all manner of free peoples are welcomed into the haven of Rivendell, so long as they show honour and good faith to their hosts and ensure no violence is committed during their stay. However, as the darkness in Middle-earth grows over the Third Age, even a place as peaceful as Rivendell must have the means to protect itself. The armies of Rivendell emulate the grandeur of those of earlier Ages; ranks of formidable Elven warriors clad in elegant armour fight side-by-side, each of them a veteran of many wars and an expert in their choice of weaponry. Yet where the armies of Rivendell really excel is through their knights. These riders are amongst the greatest in Middle- earth, with each having spent decades, if not centuries, mastering the art of fighting from horseback. Even Lord Elrond himself is an expert rider, often accompanying the Rivendell Knights when the borders of their lands are threatened by bands of Orcs or other spies of the Dark Lord. Yet should Rivendell be truly threatened, then Elrond can unleash the full might of the River Bruinen, causing it to crash down upon their foes with all the fury of the sea.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: SPECIAL RULES Protection of Imladris – Whilst within its borders, those who fight to protect Rivendell do so with renewed courage. Friendly models gain a bonus of +1 to any Courage Tests they are required to take. Defensive Stance – The Elves of Rivendell are well versed in holding fast and waiting for their foes to lunge forward, where they can exploit their enemies’ weaknesses. Friendly Elf Warrior models may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes so long as they have not Moved during the preceding Move Phase. Invoke the Bruinen – The waters of the Bruinen hold great power and in times of great peril they can be invoked to protect Rivendell by those who know how. Once per game, so long as either Elrond or Arwen are alive and on the battlefield, you may use this special rule at the start of any Move Phase in which your Army is Broken. Place a 25mm Marker anywhere within 12" and Line of Sight of Elrond or Arwen, and then roll a D6 for each enemy model within 3" of that Marker. If the roll is equal to or over the Strength of the model, or is a natural 6, then the model immediately suffers a Strength 4 hit and, if it survives, will be knocked Prone. Remove the Marker after every affected enemy model has been rolled for. book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: THE LAST ALLIANCE THE LAST ALLIANCE W hen the Dark Lord Sauron forged the Rings of Power, it wasn’t long before he began to dominate Middle-earth. One by one the free lands fell to the power of the Ring, each of them overrun by armies of Orcs sent by Sauron to destroy them. With each victory Sauron grew more powerful and it wasn’t long before the Dark Lord turned his gaze towards the greater powers in Middle-earth – yet there were some who resisted… In order to combat the ever growing threat of Sauron, a last alliance of Men and Elves was formed between the high kings, Elendil and Gil-galad. Individually, both would have been but a mere roadblock for Sauron’s armies, but together they believed themselves to be strong enough to force back the relentless tides of Mordor and finally defeat the Dark Lord for good. Marching upon Mordor, the Last Alliance of Men and Elves did battle side-by-side, and upon the slopes of Mount Doom they fought for the very fate of Middle-earth. Man and Elf arrayed against an Orc army that far surpassed their own in sheer size, showing no fear as the rabble raced towards them. Archers from both races rained arrows down upon their foes, whilst the front ranks stood stoically waiting for the Orcs to break upon their shield walls like waves on rock. Though there have been many exceptional armies over the history of Middle-earth, few have gone down in legend as important as that of the Last Alliance. For had it not been for the sacrifice of Elendil and Gil-galad, and the armies of Men and Elves in defeating the Dark Lord, then the entirety of the free lands would have been plunged into shadow, changing the very fate of Middle-earth for the Ages to come.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: LOTHLÓRIEN LOTHLÓRIEN T o the east of the Misty Mountains and on the western bank of the Anduin lies the wooded Elven realm of Lothlórien, home of the Galadhrim Elves. Unlike the dark, twisted forest of Mirkwood, Lothlórien is a place of light, sanctuary and healing; one where only the closest allies of the Elves are allowed to tread. Its paths are kept clear of the servants of the enemy, making Lothlórien one of the few safe havens in Middle-earth during the Third Age. Lothlórien itself is ruled over by Galadriel and Celeborn, two Elves of immense power that have walked Middle-earth since before the years of the First Age. Galadriel is a mighty sorceress whose power can rival any in Middle-earth, and she is able to keep the borders of her lands safe through the power of Nenya, one of the three Elven Rings. Few would dare to stand against the might of the Lady Galadriel, and those who would will find themselves on the receiving end of her wrath. Yet Lothlórien cannot be kept safe by the power of Galadriel alone. It is through the martial prowess of the Galadhrim warriors that the woodland realm has been kept free from marauding Orc bands; something that has become increasingly more common as the years of the Third Age have rolled on. The Galadhrim clad themselves in brilliant golden armour that honours the great Mallorn trees that stand tall and proud within the forest. It is these standing armies that Lothlórien will need to call upon as Sauron’s power grows, whether to protect their own lands or to aid their allies in the fights against the servants of the Dark Lord. As the sun begins to set on the Third Age, the Elves of Lothlórien ready themselves for war, preparing to stand alongside the free peoples of Middle-earth one final time, now as they have always done.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: FANGORN FANGORN A t the close of the Third Age, Middle-earth is controlled largely by a handful of great kingdoms, each ruling over huge swathes of land. However, there are still many other ancient powers within Middle- earth, lurking within the forests and vales, free from the commands of the realms of Men, Elves and Dwarves. Such beings are content to simply avoid the wars and conflicts of the wider world, keeping themselves hidden and set apart. Of these ancient lands, the forest of Fangorn is by far the oldest. Within the boughs of the great woodland dwell the Ents, the tree-shepherds of Middle-earth. Often resembling the very trees they live amongst, the Ents have been around since before the dawn of the First Age, wandering the woodland and forests of Middle-earth to protect them against any evil that would seek to corrupt them. However, in the dwindling years of the Third Age, the Ents are few in number and have taken to residing only within the forest of Fangorn itself. The Ents give little to no thought to the world outside Fangorn, instead growing weary with the weight of millennia. As the decades have rolled onwards, the forest has become unruly, and the Ents are too few in number to control all the trees under their protection. With the Ents prone to sleeping for years at a time, they were oblivious to the rising threat of Isengard and also to the relentless march of Saruman’s flames of industry, resulting in the forest near Isengard being ripped up to fuel its forges. It is upon the discovery of Saruman’s treachery that the Ents are finally stirred into action. Treebeard, the greatest of the tree-shepherds, lets forth a mighty call, rousing the slumbering Ents from their deep sleep and summoning them to march to war with Isengard. Though they may well be marching to their doom, the Ents are determined to seek revenge for their kind felled by Saruman’s armies and plan on breaking the dam and releasing the pent-up River Isen in order to wash away the filth of Saruman forever.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: THE EAGLES H igh up in the peaks of the Misty Mountains nest the Great Eagles. These ancient and noble beings see themselves as above the petty squabbles and goings-on of those beneath their lofty perch, seeing them as little more than ants they need not concern themselves with. Yet the Great Eagles are far more than mere beasts, possessing an incredible intellect and fierce predatory instinct – a combination seldom seen within Middle-earth. As it turns out, there are few in Middle-earth that are aware of the Great Eagles’ existence, and fewer still who can say they have ridden upon these proud beasts. The Eagles are not quick to trust those they meet, and those that come face-to- face with them must be cautious to prove they are an ally or risk being torn to shreds by their huge, razor-sharp talons. It is said that only the Wizards have earned true friendship with the Eagles, though quite how this friendship was formed is a mystery to all but the Istari and the Great Eagles themselves. THE EAGLES This friendship has proved fruitful a number of times during the latter years of the Third Age. When the company of Thorin Oakenshield found themselves trapped by Azog’s Hunters, it was the Eagles who rescued them from certain death. The Eagles also came to aid the free peoples of Middle-earth at the Battle of the Five Armies and the Black Gate, doing their part to rid Middle-earth of darkness. When Gandalf found himself trapped atop Orthanc, it was Gwaihir, the Lord of the Eagles, who rescued his friend from the clutches of Saruman, flying him away to safety. Though the Great Eagles may wish to remain apart from the goings-on beneath their roost, the growing threat of Sauron means that even the Eagles will be forced to do their part for good. For should the Dark Lord prevail and reclaim the One Ring, then Middle-earth will be wreathed in shadow and the Eagles will suffer the same fate as all the other races of Middle-earth.

content: REALMS OF MEN WRITING AN ARMY LIST FOR KINGS OF MEN Kings of Men are used to represent the many kings or rulers that the race of Men has had over the ages, and as such they do not fit into any of the standard Army Lists presented within the Middle-earth Strategy Battle Game. Instead, they form their own Army List referred to as the Realms of Men. When writing a Realms of Men Army List, there are some things to make a note of: Kings of Men are always a Hero of Legend. A King of Men may include Warrior models in their Warband from any Army List, so long as they share the same Faction Keyword. When working out which King of Men is your Army’s General, it must be the one which shares the most common Faction Keyword throughout your Army. For example, if the most common Faction Keyword in your Army is Rohan, then the King of Men with the Rohan Keyword must be your General. A Realms of Men Army may not have two Kings of Men with the same Faction Keyword; however, they may have multiple Kings of Men with different Faction Keywords. A Realms of Men Army can never include any models with the Unique Keyword under any circumstances. However, it can include Hero models without the Unique Keyword so long as they share a Faction Keyword with a King of Men already in the Army. For example, a Realms of Men Army with a King of Men with the Gondor Keyword could include a Captain of Minas Tirith as they would both have the Gondor Keyword. Hero models included in this manner may also include Warrior models in their Warband with the same Faction Keyword. The Realms of Men Army List allows you to create your own forces and combine multiple factions of Men in a way that suits you. REALMS OF MEN

It was under his rule that the kingdom of Angmar rose in the north, becoming a mighty realm of terror and evil, and causing the downfall of Arnor. The Witch-king’s very presence on the battlefield fills his enemies with a deep sense of despair, one that can make even the boldest of hearts tremble with fear. Amongst all the evils in Middle-earth, none, save Sauron himself, is more feared than the Witch-king – the one they say no living man can kill. Tasked with leading the assault upon Osgiliath and Minas Tirith, Gothmog commands huge swathes of Morannon Orcs to crush the realm of Gondor. Though his martial prowess has been diminished by injury, Gothmog has maintained his position at the head of the Orc armies through a combination of sheer ruthlessness and a brilliant tactical mind – a trait that is seldom seen within the race of Orcs. WARGEAR Heavy armour and hand weapon. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic Defence Heroic March OPTIONS Warg ...............................................................................20 points Shield ................................................................................5 points SPECIAL RULES Master of Battle (2+) “The Age of Men is Over” PASSIVE – Gothmog sees it as his duty to bring an end to the race of Men and see the Orcs become the dominant race. Friendly Mordor Orc models within 3" of Gothmog gain the Hatred (Man) special rule. “The time of the Orc has come” ACTIVE – The Orcs that fight under Gothmog’s command will follow him with unrivalled zeal to ensure they conquer their foes. book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Though the majority of Orc Captains within Mordor’s armies have gained their position through their strength and savagery, the same is not true for Gothmog’s Enforcer. Instead, it is this Orc’s unwavering loyalty and subservience to Gothmog that has seen him gain the post he now holds, relaying his master’s commands across the battlefield with authority. Whether his loyalty to Gothmog is out of admiration, or more likely cowardice, remains unknown, though it is likely of little relevance to Gothmog. Race ORC Faction MORDOR Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE Base size 25MM Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 4 5+ 4 6 2 2 7+ 6+ GOTHMOG’S ENFORCER ..............55 POINTS 3 1 1 WARGEAR Heavy armour and hand weapon. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic Defence SPECIAL RULES Gothmog’s Right Hand PASSIVE – Gothmog’s Enforcer will often be found behind the lines at the side of his commander, barking Gothmog’s orders across the battlefield. Whilst Gothmog’s Enforcer is within 3" of Gothmog, then Gothmog can spend Gothmog’s Enforcer’s Will Points to declare a Heroic Move or Heroic March instead of using his own Might Points. Additionally, when Gothmog declares a Heroic Move or Heroic March within 3" of Gothmog’s Enforcer, Gothmog can measure the range of the With Me or At the Double from Gothmog’s Enforcer rather than himself if he wishes. Base size 25MM Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 4 5+ 5 6 2 2 7+ 6+ Race ORC Faction MORDOR GURITZ, MASTER OF RESERVES.......65 POINTS A canny and calculating Orc, Guritz is a veteran of many wars and has gained a great deal of experience fighting against the armies of Gondor. Guritz is tasked with marshalling the reserve force at the Battle of Pelennor Fields, directing Sauron’s allies to where they are most needed to crush the Dark Lord’s enemies. It is these skills that Guritz plans to use to direct the Corsairs of Umbar towards the White City, plans that are ultimately unravelled by the Three Hunters and the Army of the Dead. 2 2 1 Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE WARGEAR Heavy armour, two-handed weapon and hand weapon. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic March SPECIAL RULES Master of Reserves PASSIVE – An Orc with a keen understanding of ambush and tactics, Guritz is in charge of ensuring that Gothmog’s reinforcements arrive at the right time. In Scenarios where you roll for Warbands to arrive, or ones where you roll to see which part of the board you deploy a Warband in (though not when rolling to choose deployment zones), you may modify the roll for Guritz’s Warband by +1 or -1, even if he is not on the battlefield. If Guritz is on the battlefield, you may also modify the roll for other Warbands in your Army by +1 or -1. End the Race of Men ACTIVE – The Orcs of the Morannon have been given a single mission – to eradicate the race of Men. Whilst Engaged in Combat with an enemy Man model, this model gains a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value.

Speaking on behalf of his master in matters of politics and his own variation of grim diplomacy, the Mouth of Sauron is both revered and feared within the armies of Mordor. Though he has still kept his skill with a blade, the Mouth of Sauron has also been tutored by his master in matters of dark sorceries, making him a truly deadly foe to face. content: 0 6 0 Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 10" 7 4+ 7 7 1 6 6+ 5+ Base size 60MM Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, MONSTER, BEAST, UNIQUE Faction MORDOR Race SPIDER It is said that a dark terror stalks the mountain pass high above Cirith Ungol, traversing its winding tunnels and hunting any who stray into its domain. This creature is Shelob, the spawn of Ungoliant; a giant, bloated spider that has dwelt within Mordor for millennia. Over the Ages, countless beings have been ensnared in the webs of Shelob. Yet Shelob likes to feed on fresh, warm blood, and prefers to inject her prey with a paralysing venom, before entangling them in webbing to save for a later time. The pass of Cirith Ungol has long been thought of as a terrible place, for few can say they have braved its caverns and lived to tell the tale. SHELOB ..................................................................................................100 POINTS WARGEAR Fangs (hand weapon). SPECIAL RULES Dominant (4), Monstrous Charge, Survival Instinct, Swift Movement, Terror, Venom Lone Hunter PASSIVE – Shelob hunts alone and few would dare to follow her too closely when she is stalking her prey. Shelob may never be included in another model’s Warband. Additionally, Shelob can never benefit from the Heroic Actions of other models. “She is always hungry” PASSIVE – Shelob is always hungry and is constantly looking to feed upon fresh blood, no matter the source. At the start of her Activation, so long as she is not Engaged in Combat, Shelob can choose to kill a friendly model within 1" of her – remove the chosen model as a casualty. If she does, until the end of the turn Shelob may re-roll a single dice during any Duel Roll she participates in. “She hungers for sweeter meats” PASSIVE – If the chance to feast upon something that isn’t the usual pickings of Orc or Goblin arises, Shelob will seize it with great relish. Shelob adds 1 to her Attacks characteristic whilst she is Engaged in Combat with an enemy Man, Elf, Dwarf or Hobbit model. Caught in a Web BRUTAL POWER ATTACK – Though she enjoys the hunt, Shelob’s preferred method of feeding is to inject her prey with venom and save them for later. Instead of making Strikes, Shelob may instead choose a single enemy model that was involved in the Combat. The chosen model immediately suffers a single Strength 8 hit and, if it survives, will be subject to the Paralyse Magical Power – however, the model will not automatically recover should Shelob be removed as a casualty, leave the board or be reduced to 0 Will Points.

content: Race URUK-HAI Faction MORDOR Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE Base size 25MM 3 3 3 Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 6 4+ 5 5 3 3 5+ 5+ Across the many years he has spent in service to the Dark Lord, Shagrat has commanded numerous garrisons and armies, emerging victorious from countless battles through sheer brute force. During the War of the Ring, Shagrat has been made Captain of Cirith Ungol. However, being forced to share command of the garrison with the Orc Captain, Gorbag, tensions between the two quickly rise as Shagrat isn’t one to share power willingly. SHAGRAT, CAPTAIN OF CIRITH UNGOL ...........................................110 POINTS WARGEAR Armour and hand weapon. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic Challenge Heroic Strength Heroic Strike SPECIAL RULES General Hunter “Hands off the shiny shirt; that’s mine!” ACTIVE An Uruk-hai out to gather riches for himself, Shagrat will not entertain the thought of sharing loot with anyone. During a Scenario that involves picking up and carrying Objectives, Shagrat can use this special rule at any point during his Move. If he does, he may select any friendly model within 3" that is carrying an Objective and take an Intelligence Test. If the test is passed, Shagrat immediately gains possession of that Objective, even if the Scenario would not normally allow for that Objective to be passed. Additionally, Shagrat can always carry multiple Objectives, even if the Scenario would state that models can only carry one. Cleaving Blow ACTIVE – Mordor Uruk-hai possess great strength and are easily capable of severing limbs, cutting through armour and splintering shields with a well- timed blow. If this model rolls a natural 6 To Wound when making a Strike, and the Wound is successful, then the target will suffer 2 Wounds rather than 1.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Base size 25MM Race ORC Faction MORDOR Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE 3 2 1 Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 5 5+ 4 5 2 2 6+ 5+ The leader of the Mordor Orcs stationed at Cirith Ungol, Gorbag is renowned for his cunning and vicious nature. Quite unlike the dimwitted Orcs under his command, Gorbag possesses a shrewd intelligence setting him apart from others of his race. This doesn’t make Gorbag any less ruthless, in fact, it is this that allows him to employ a series of unusual fighting styles to fend off any who would seek to challenge his command and slaughter him. Even when Cirith Ungol erupts into turmoil, Gorbag is able to fight off numerous Mordor Uruk-hai with relative ease, and only meets his end when he is unprepared and Samwise thrusts Sting through his back. GORBAG, ORC CAPTAIN.......................................................................60 POINTS WARGEAR Armour and hand weapon. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic Challenge Heroic Strike SPECIAL RULES Orcish Brawler ACTIVE – Gorbag is a dangerous and cunning fighter, though it is when he is surrounded that he is most dangerous, lashing out at his foes with deadly accuracy. If Gorbag is outnumbered in a Combat, he increases his Attacks to 3 for the duration of the Combat. Adaptive Fighter ACTIVE – Having been involved in many fights across the lands of Mordor, Gorbag knows how to use his surroundings to his own advantage – especially if his foe is near a sudden drop… If Gorbag wins a Duel Roll, then before models Back Away Gorbag may choose a single enemy model involved in the combat. The chosen model is Backed Away in a direction chosen by Gorbag. This direction may be chosen so that the model is forced to Back Away over the edge of a cliff, in which case they will suffer falling damage as normal. Once this has been resolved, other models Back Away as normal and Strikes are resolved. However, if a model has been Backed Away over the edge of a cliff as described earlier, Gorbag cannot make Strikes against that model.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Unlike the captains of more civilised races, those that command the hordes of Mordor Orcs are chosen due to their brute strength and savage nature rather than any semblance of tactical prowess. To the races of Men and Elves, an Orc Captain is just another Orc charging into the fray as part of a vile, endless swarm. However, to the Orcs, these captains are the envy of those they command, able to bellow orders to those below them and getting the first pick of any loot and fresh meat. Base size 25MM Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY Faction MORDOR Race ORC 2 1 1 Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 4 5+ 4 6 2 2 7+ 7+ MORDOR ORC CAPTAIN ...............45 POINTS WARGEAR Armour, shield and hand weapon. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic March Base size 25MM Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY Faction MORDOR Race ORC Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 4 5+ 4 5 2 2 7+ 7+ MORDOR ORC TASKMASTER ......45 POINTS Taskmasters are Orcs who have shown a particular viciousness, and take great glee in the maiming of their foes. Such skills do not go unnoticed within Mordor, and these Orcs have been rewarded with the chance to apply their barbarism both on the battlefield and on their own kind. It is the job of the Taskmaster to keep their troops in line, using great whips to lash out at any Orcs who show even a glimpse of insubordination and ensuring that the will of the Great Eye is always obeyed. 1 1 1 WARGEAR Armour, hand weapon and whip. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic March SPECIAL RULES Whips of the Master ACTIVE – Standing behind allied lines, Taskmasters will bellow out commands and use their whips to drive their followers into battle. Whenever a friendly Hero model within 6" declares a Heroic Move, Heroic March or Heroic Shoot, roll a D6. On a 4+ the Hero does not spend the Might Point and the Heroic Action is free.

It should come as little surprise that Orcs make for the perfect tool for the armies of the Dark Lord, for they are drawn to all manner of evil and will gladly take up arms for any who promises them bloodshed and destruction. Though they are an inherently cowardly race, Orcs will often try to weasel themselves up the ranks of Sauron’s armies – backstabbing and betraying their own kind for their own gain. These crude war machines may not look as though they are at the peak of engineering, yet they have proved to be highly effective over the course of many battles. Huge Trolls load rocks into the catapult before they are flung across the battlefield. book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: As the years have passed, new strains of Orcs have been bred within Mordor. Designed to guard the Black Gate, the Morannon Orcs are stronger, tougher and more savage than the Orcs that man Sauron’s other bastions. Clad in thick plated armour rather than rags and leathers, the Morannon Orcs fight in a more orderly fashion than the rabbles of lesser Orcs. It is these Orcs that Sauron has unleashed upon the kingdom of Gondor, for they will stop at nothing to end the race of Men. book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: The armies of Mordor are made up of more than just Orcs, with some fortresses garrisoned by scores of ferocious Mordor Uruk-hai. Stronger than Orcs and less prone to fleeing the battlefield, Mordor Uruk-hai pose a serious threat to anyone forced to face them. Their sole purpose is to tear foes apart, either using their cleavers to cut through flesh with huge swinging blows or using their muscular frames to literally rip enemies limb from limb. Huge, snarling beasts with a hunger for flesh, these fearsome warriors fight with a brutality that rivals even the strongest of Mordor’s warriors. On the battlefield these Uruks are a terrible force, swinging their weapons with great cleaving blows that can take a foe’s arm clean off and revelling in the destruction they wrought with a grim malice. book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Bred by the Dark Lord to withstand the rays of the sun, the Trolls of Mordor are amongst the most deadly of their race. Towering over the forces of Men and Elves, these lumbering creatures smash aside any who stand before them, relishing in the carnage they leave in their wake. These monsters are used to great effect in the armies of Mordor, sent charging into battle at the very front of an army with the intent of causing the enemy to rout and flee, and crushing those who do attempt to stand and fight. Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 7 5+ 7 7 3 4 6+ 8+ MORDOR TROLL............................90 POINTS Base size 60MM Base size 60MM Race TROLL Race TROLL Faction MORDOR Faction MORDOR Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, MONSTER Unit Type WARRIOR, INFANTRY, MONSTER 2 1 1 Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 8 4+ 7 8 3 4 6+ 6+ MORDOR TROLL CHIEFTAIN............150 POINTS Though not inherently intelligent creatures, every now and then a Troll shows enough cunning to be more than just a mindless beast. These Trolls are given the rank of chieftain, and are even capable of leading portions of the Dark Lord’s armies into battle. If a fearsome Mordor Troll wasn’t a daunting enough foe, then one that can also grasp the ideas of tactics and battleplans makes for a truly terrifying enemy – one that is more than capable of smashing aside even the greatest heroes of the Third Age with frightening ease. content: Base size 25MM Unit Type WARRIOR, INFANTRY Faction MORDOR Race SPIRIT Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 2 6+ 3 6 1 1 4+ 7+ SPECTRE............................................15 POINTS Spectres are the ghostly, undead forms of those who were felled in the wars of the Second Age, returned to a ruined form of unlife by malign sorceries. No longer serving those they fought for in life, these apparitions now serve the very evil that has caused them to linger. Whether in the ruins of Angmar or in the waters of the Dead Marshes, many travellers have been led to their doom by following the unnatural glow exuded from these Spectres, causing them to stray into their clutches and light little lights of their own… WARGEAR Heavy armour and hand weapon. SPECIAL RULES Blades of the Dead, Spectral Walk, Terror A fell light is in them ACTIVE – The ethereal call of a spectre of the Dead Marshes can invade the minds of the unwitting, leading them astray and into grave danger. At the end of this model’s Move, it can choose a single enemy model within 12" and Line of Sight. The chosen model must take an Intelligence Test. If the test is failed, you may Move the chosen model up to its Move Value directly towards this model, even if it has already Moved that turn. The chosen model will stop Moving if it would enter the Control Zone of an enemy model (with the exception of this model), if it comes into contact with an Obstacle, another model (though they will never count as Charging in this instance, and therefore cannot be involved in Combat with the model) or piece of impassable terrain, or if the model reaches the edge of a cliff or other such edge that would cause it to take falling damage. This Move cannot be used to Move a model out of Combat, make a model dismount, drop an item or Lie Down. However, if this Move would allow the chosen model to Charge this model, then this model may make them Charge. A model affected by this special rule cannot Move any further that turn, and may not use Active abilities.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: The Easterlings are a proud warrior race from the land of Rhûn; a land virtually unmapped by the Men of the West. Fanatically devoted to the Dark Lord and his cause, these zealous warriors are trained in the art of warfare from as soon as they are able to hold a blade. Each Easterling warrior is a skilled fighter and is trained to show no mercy on the battlefield, ruthlessly slaughtering any who would attempt to surrender. Whilst the likes of Orcs may quiver and flee should the battle turn ill, Easterlings will stand and fight until the bitter end – standing stoically in their golden armour. Base size 25MM Unit Type WARRIOR, INFANTRY Faction EASTERLING Race MAN Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 4 4+ 3 5 1 1 7+ 6+ EASTERLING WARRIOR..................8 POINTS 2 1 1 Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 5 4+ 4 6 2 2 6+ 5+ Base size 25MM Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY Faction EASTERLING Race MAN Within the culture of the Easterlings of Rhûn, nothing is more important than the ability to wield a blade. A strong martial code runs deep within the veins of all Easterlings, and those who rise to the rank of captain are revered throughout the armies of the east. Ruthless, unwavering and highly skilled with a blade, these captains are exemplars of everything that the Easterlings desire in their warriors. Though they may be callous and cruel leaders, their followers will fight for their captains no matter the odds, for none will want to feel their captain’s wrath should they fail. EASTERLING CAPTAIN.................60 POINTS WARGEAR Heavy armour and Easterling Halberd. Easterling Halberd ACTIVE – This can be used as either a pike or a two- handed weapon. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic March SPECIAL RULES Phalanx ACTIVE – The Easterlings are constantly drilled in the art of war. They can fight in tightly-knit formations and wield bladed pikes with ease. A model with this special rule can use a pike and a shield at the same time without penalty. Additionally, should an Infantry model with this special rule lose a Combat, up to two friendly models with this special rule can Make Way instead of one. WARGEAR Heavy armour and hand weapon. In doing so, Saruman became a twisted form of his previous self; no longer a wise and noble Istari but instead a tyrannical and cruel being who would use his mastery of magic to bend others to his will. What Saruman hoped to gain through his betrayal of the free peoples is unknown but he nonetheless turned his sorcerous powers against the likes of Gandalf, demanded the forest of Fangorn be ripped down and sentenced thousands of Rohirrim to die by fire and sword as his Uruk-hai rampaged across their lands. Saruman’s Deceit PASSIVE – With poisoned words, Saruman weaves a web of lies to weaken the minds of his enemies. At the beginning of the game, after both sides have deployed, Saruman may choose a single enemy Hero. The chosen Hero suffers a -1 penalty to any Resist Tests they take when targeted by a Magical Power Cast by Saruman; though a natural 6 will still count as a 6. content: Race MAN Base size 25MM Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE 0 0 0 Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 2 4+ 3 3 1 1 8+ 6+ Faction ISENGARD The puppet of Saruman, Gríma Wormtongue was a Man of Rohan who willingly sold his services to the White Wizard in exchange for promises of wealth and power. It was through his role as Théoden’s advisor that Gríma was able to do the most harm, whispering words of despair in the king’s ear and seeing him fall under the control of Saruman. Through the poisonous words of Gríma, Théoden became stripped of his will to act and only sat there oblivious as the Westfold burned around Rohan. Though he is no warrior, Gríma’s strength lies instead in his ability to weave words to twist the minds of those around him, robbing even the most wise of their heroism. GRÍMA WORMTONGUE ................25 POINTS WARGEAR Hand weapon. SPECIAL RULES Wormtongue PASSIVE – The tainted words spoken by Gríma provide a combination of twisted truths and ill-serving advice. An enemy Hero within 6" of Gríma must spend 2 Might Points rather than 1 in order to declare a Heroic Action. A Traitor Within PASSIVE – Within the council of Edoras, Gríma’s true purpose went undetected until Gandalf rooted out his wicked ways. Gríma can be deployed in one of two ways, though his controlling player must decide which before either Army is deployed. Gríma can either be deployed as part of Saruman’s Warband (in which case he will not take up a space in the Warband), or as part of the enemy Army. If Gríma chooses to be deployed as part of the enemy Army, he must select an enemy Hero. Once that Hero and their Warband has been deployed, Gríma’s controlling player can deploy Gríma as if he was also part of that Warband, following all the usual deployment rules. Gríma is still part of his controlling player’s Army, and will Activate like any other model in his controlling player’s Army. If Gríma is deployed as part of the enemy Army, then enemy models treat him as a friendly model, and therefore cannot shoot him, Charge him, make Strikes against him, target him with special rules, or make a shooting attack in which Gríma would be In The Way. They may also ignore his Control Zone. They can, however, target him with Magical Powers like any other enemy model. Whilst Gríma is considered a friendly model, Gríma may ignore the Control Zones of enemy models and may Move through enemy models as if they weren’t there. When Gríma Moves this way, he cannot end his Move overlapping or in base contact with an enemy model. Gríma can choose to Charge an enemy model as normal if he wishes. These restrictions immediately end if Saruman is slain, if Gríma Charges an enemy model, if Gríma destroys an enemy Siege Engine, or if Gríma interacts with an Objective Marker (such as destroying a Supply Marker or picking up an objective), at which point Gríma is treated as a normal enemy model and can be Charged, shot at and slain like any other model.

content: Base size 25MM Race URUK-HAI Faction ISENGARD Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 6 3+ 5 6 3 3 4+ 5+ 3 3 1 One of the first to emerge from the pits of Isengard, of all Saruman’s Uruk-hai none are as mighty as Lurtz. It was Lurtz who led the mission to capture the Ringbearer, commanding a full contingent of scouting Uruk-hai as they ran tirelessly in search of their quarry. Lurtz is ruthlessly strong, even amongst the ranks of the Uruk-hai, and able to unleash arrows with such precision and strength that they cleave through both armour and flesh. It is such strength that Lurtz uses to slay Boromir, and even Aragorn nearly met an end against this fearsome Uruk-hai. LURTZ, URUK-HAI SCOUT CAPTAIN..........................100 POINTS WARGEAR Armour, hand weapon and Uruk-hai bow. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic Challenge Heroic March Heroic Strength Heroic Strike OPTIONS Shield ................................................................................................................Free (this will not increase Lurtz’s Defence as he also carries an Uruk-hai bow) SPECIAL RULES Sharpshooter “Find the Halflings” ACTIVE – Lurtz is a skilled hunter and tracker, and is relentlessly driven by Saruman’s orders to find the Hobbits and the trinket they carry. In Scenarios that use the Maelstrom of Battle special rule, Lurtz’s Warband does not roll to determine where they arrive. Instead, Lurtz may choose the result. Shield Throw PASSIVE – Lurtz is an exceptional fighter and is more than adept at using all manner of wargear as a makeshift weapon if he is required to. If Lurtz has been equipped with a shield, then once per game Lurtz can use it as a throwing weapon and may re-roll the To Hit Roll. This has a Strength of 4 and any model on a 25mm base that is hit will immediately be knocked Prone. Once Lurtz has thrown his shield, he no longer carries it; though Lurtz’s Defence will not be reduced as a result. Oblivious to Pain PASSIVE – Relentless and savage, Lurtz’s drive to do his master’s bidding can see him shrug off wounds that would fell others of his kind. Whenever Lurtz suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On the roll of a natural 6, the Wound is ignored.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Base size 25MM 1 3 1 Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE Faction ISENGARD Race URUK-HAI Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 5 4+ 5 5 2 2 6+ 6+ UGLÚK, URUK-HAI SCOUT CAPTAIN.............................75 POINTS A captain in Lurtz’s raiding force, it is Uglúk who takes up command of the Uruk-hai Scouts following his commander’s demise at Amon Hen. With two Hobbit prisoners in their clutches, Uglúk drives his warriors back to Isengard with as much speed as they can muster. Uglúk demands complete obedience from his followers, and will not suffer those who attempt to undermine him. When Grishnákh’s Orcs threaten his prisoners, Uglúk is swift to act – restoring order with a brutal swing of his blade. WARGEAR Armour, hand weapon and whip. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic March Heroic Strength Heroic Strike SPECIAL RULES Head Taker ACTIVE – Uglúk is a ruthless leader and any who defy him will quickly be made an example of to ensure that the others fall in line. Should Uglúk’s Army be Broken, then at the start of his Activation, instead of taking his Courage Test Uglúk can choose to kill a friendly Warrior model within 2" of him; remove the killed model as a casualty. If he does, then Uglúk will automatically pass his Courage Test, and his Stand Fast will be increased to 12" and will affect both Hero and Warrior models. “Looks like meat’s back on the menu, boys!” ACTIVE – Sometimes the best way to keep a rabble of Orcs in line is through force; a principle Uglúk gladly embodies. At the start of his Activation, Uglúk can kill a friendly Orc Warrior within 2" of him; remove the killed model as a casualty. If Uglúk does this, then all friendly Uruk-hai models within 6" of him gain the Fearless special rule and gain a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes until the end of the turn. If Uglúk does this in a turn in which his Army is Broken, then it will also count as triggering the Head Taker rule above.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Base size 25MM A sneaky and vindictive Orc who was never one for following orders, Snaga was part of the Orc band sent by Sauron to keep an eye on his puppet, Saruman. Along with Grishnákh and his Orcs, Snaga met with Uglúk’s scouts following their capture of Merry and Pippin to ensure the Halflings reached Isengard. Yet, having not eaten properly in days, Snaga’s mind turned towards eating their prisoners – something that ultimately results in Snaga becoming the main course. Race ORC Faction ISENGARD Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE Base size 25MM Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 4 4+ 4 5 2 2 7+ 6+ SNAGA, ORC CAPTAIN..................50 POINTS Grishnákh leads the Orcs sent from Minas Morgul to keep an eye on Saruman’s progress. A ruthless and calculating Orc, Grishnákh has risen through the Orcish ranks by honing his skills over years of combat and the raiding of settlements. Grishnákh shares his followers’ desire to feast upon their Hobbit captives, and when the Orcs and Uruk-hai are slaughtered by Éomer’s Éored, Grishnákh follows Merry and Pippin into Fangorn – where he meets an end befitting of an Orcish intruder… Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE Faction ISENGARD Race ORC 2 2 2 1 1 1 Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 4 5+ 4 5 2 2 7+ 5+ GRISHNÁKH, ORC CAPTAIN ........55 POINTS WARGEAR Armour and hand weapon. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic Strike SPECIAL RULES Backstabbers “Let’s put a maggot hole in your belly” ACTIVE – Grishnákh is a cunning Orc and will aim to gain an advantage on his prey by throwing them to the floor before moving in for the kill. If Grishnákh wins a Duel Roll, and there are no other allies involved in the Combat (including Supporting models), then Grishnákh can choose a single enemy model on a 25mm base that he was Engaged in Combat with and roll a D6. On a 4+, the chosen model is knocked Prone before Strikes are made. WARGEAR Armour and hand weapon. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic Challenge SPECIAL RULES Cunning Mind PASSIVE – Though he may not possess much in the way of martial skill, Snaga is a cagey Orc who has his own agenda. Whenever Snaga benefits from the Heroic Action of an other friendly Hero, he may roll a D6. On a 5+, Snaga may regain a Might Point that he spent earlier in the battle. Additionally, Snaga may choose to not benefit from the Heroic Move or Heroic March of a friendly Hero, in which case he does not forego his Activation and may Activate as normal later in the Move Phase.

content: Base size 25MM Unit Type WARRIOR, INFANTRY Faction ISENGARD Race URUK-HAI Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 5 4+ 4 5 2 1 3+ 8+ The most brutal and barbaric of the Uruk-hai are the Berserkers – frenzied killers who are hurled into battle to break enemy lines and cleave their way through rank upon rank. Before being unleashed upon the battlefield, their helmets are filled with blood and then thrust roughly onto their heads. It is to this end that the Wizard called for the grounds of Isengard to be ripped up, turning them into a series of pits and breeding grounds for his new army – the fighting Uruk-hai. These hideous creations are amongst the greatest warriors in the service of the Dark Lord; standing as tall and broad as the mightiest of Men, resistant to the sun’s rays and able to fight without tiring. It is these armies that Saruman has unleashed upon Middle-earth, clad in thick, plated armour and armed with all manner of iron-forged weapons from the furnaces beneath Isengard. book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: The armies of Isengard that assail Helm’s Deep are no mindless rabble of Orcs or Goblins, instead they are a highly drilled and well-ordered host of fighting Uruk-hai. Alongside the Uruk-hai, huge assault ballistae are wheeled into position, prepared to launch great bolts at those on the fortress walls. These bolts have two uses: either to impale those in their path or to have their ends tied to great siege ladders which can then be used to raise them against the fortress – allowing hordes of Uruk-hai to effortlessly clamber onto the walls of Helm’s Deep. ISENGARD ASSAULT BALLISTA ...........................................................75 POINTS SPECIAL RULES Direct Shot Accurate ACTIVE – An Isengard Assault Ballista will only Scatter 3" rather than 6". Raise the Ladders ACTIVE – In a siege game, an Isengard Assault Ballista can be used to raise a ladder onto enemy battlements. To do this, choose a point on the battlements within range, Arc of Sight and Line of Sight of the Ballista and roll To Hit as usual. If the To Hit Roll is successful, place a siege ladder that is within 6" of the wall base below the target point against the battlements. A single model that was carrying the ladder can then be placed at the top of this ladder, and will count as Charging if there is a defender at the top of the battlements where the ladder was raised. If not, the model can Move as normal. Piercing Shot ACTIVE – A model that is hit by the shot of an Isengard Assault Ballista will be flung back D6" directly away from the Ballista if it has a Strength of 5 or lower. Any model that is passed over by the flung model suffers a Strength 5 hit and will be knocked Prone. If the flung model comes into contact with a piece of impassable terrain or a model with a Strength of 6 or higher, then it will stop and both the flung model and the model or piece of terrain that was hit will suffer one Strength 6 hit. After being flung back, the flung model will be knocked Prone if they survive. If after the model is flung back it would finish over other models and it has survived, then simply move the other models the minimum distance possible to allow the flung model to be placed where it has landed. COMPOSITION An Isengard Assault Ballista is a Large Siege Engine, and is crewed by three Uruk-hai Siege Crew, one of which is a Siege Veteran, which use the profile below: Race URUK-HAI Faction ISENGARD Unit Type WARRIOR, INFANTRY Base size 25MM Base size 105MM OVAL Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 4 4+ 4 5 1 1 7+ 7+ URUK-HAI SIEGE CREW WARGEAR Armour and hand weapon. book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Saruman is not simply content to unleash his armies upon the Rohirrim, he wants to make them suffer and see their kingdom crumble around them. To this end, Saruman has created explosive demolition charges – great metal structures filled with black powder that can be detonated with devastating effect in an explosion of flame and stone. It is the whispered treachery of Gríma Wormtongue that has revealed to his master where these devices will be of best use – the culvert built into the walls of Helm’s Deep… URUK-HAI DEMOLITION TEAM ..........................................................80 POINTS COMPOSITION An Uruk-hai Demolition Team contains 2 Uruk-hai Engineers, 1 Uruk-hai Berserker with torch and 1 Demolition Charge. The Uruk-hai Engineers use the profile below; the Uruk-hai Berserker uses the profile on page 166. Race URUK-HAI Faction ISENGARD Unit Type WARRIOR, INFANTRY Base size 25MM Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 4 4+ 4 5 1 1 6+ 7+ URUK-HAI ENGINEER WARGEAR Heavy armour and hand weapon. Moving the Charge – The Demolition Charge is a Heavy Object on a 25mm base, and is Moved in the same manner as any other Heavy Object. Detonating the Charge – During the Fight Phase, after any Heroic Combats have been resolved, a model with a torch can attempt to detonate the Demolition Charge if they are in base contact with it and are not Engaged in Combat. A model may only attempt to detonate a Demolition Charge if the resulting explosion would hit a Siege Target or at least two enemy models. A model that wishes to detonate the Demolition Charge must first take a Courage Test. If the test is failed, the Demolition Charge cannot be detonated. If the test is passed, the Demolition Charge will go off – roll on the Detonation Table below: DETONATION TABLE D6 Result 1 Dud – The Demolition Charge is faulty and does not explode. Remove it from play. 2-5 Instant Reaction – The Demolition Charge explodes. All models (friend and foe) within 2" of the Demolition Charge suffer D6 Wounds. Cavalry models suffer these Wounds on both the rider and the Mount. Models with Fate Points or special rules that can prevent Wounds must make a roll for each Wound suffered; a successful roll to prevent a Wound will only stop one, not all Wounds. 6 Titanic Explosion – The Demolition Charge explodes as described above, with the exception that models take 2D6 Wounds rather than D6. A model without a torch can still attempt to detonate a Demolition Charge, though it will be harder to do. Any model from the same army as the Demolition Charge can attempt to detonate it by taking a Courage Test as described above. However, if the test is passed, roll a D6 – the Demolition Charge will only go off on the roll of a natural 6. Attacking the Charge – A Demolition Charge can be shot at and attacked as normal, and has a Defence of 7 and 3 Wounds. Each time a Demolition Charge suffers a Wound, roll a D6. On a 6, the Demolition Charge goes off; roll on the Demolition Table. If a Demolition Charge is Wounded by the explosion of another Demolition Charge, it will go off on the roll of a 4+ rather than a 6. If a Demolition Charge loses its last Wound and does not go off, it simply breaks and is removed from play. If, during the End Phase of a turn, an enemy model is in base contact with a Demolition Charge, that model hasn’t done anything during that turn except Move (i.e., has not made a shooting attack, Cast a Magical Power, been Engaged in Combat), and that model was not affected by a Magical Power that turn, then it can disable the Demolition Charge – remove it from play.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Base size 25MM An Orc with a shrewder cunning than most of those in the ranks of Isengard’s armies, Sharku is the commander of the Wolves of Isengard. When the Rohirrim attempt to make for the safety of Helm’s Deep, it is Sharku who is tasked with hunting them down and killing them on the road, an act he takes great relish in performing. Few amongst Orc-kind can ride a Warg as well as Sharku, and those who find themselves on the receiving end of a charge from Sharku and his Warg are only a swift snap of the jaws away from an unpleasant demise. Race ORC Faction ISENGARD Unit Type HERO, CAVALRY, UNIQUE 3 1 1 Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 4 5+ 4 5 2 2 6+ 6+ SHARKU, WARG RIDER CAPTAIN .................70 POINTS WARGEAR Armour, Riding Dagger and Warg. Riding Dagger ACTIVE – This is a hand weapon. Additionally, whenever an enemy model makes a Strike against Sharku (but not his Warg) and fails the To Wound Roll, Sharku may immediately make a single Strength 4 hit against that model. Whilst he has the Cavalry keyword, whenever Sharku Charges he increases his Fight Value to 5 and his Attacks to 3 until the End Phase of the turn.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Not all the Wargs in Isengard are able to be controlled, some prove to be far too unruly or savage to be ridden, throwing any Orcs who attempt to do so to the ground before feeding upon them. However, this doesn’t prevent them from joining Isengard’s Warg Rider packs; in fact, many such bands will be accompanied by some of these unridden Wargs, and whilst the Warg Riders will circle and wait for the best time to strike, these beasts will go straight for the throat. Base size 40MM Race WARG Faction ISENGARD Unit Type WARRIOR, INFANTRY, BEAST Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 10" 3 6+ 4 4 1 1 8+ 8+ ISENGARD WARG.............................7 POINTS Of all the Orcs that serve Saruman, perhaps the most deadly in his service are the Warg Riders – Orcs who have managed to exert some form of control over the vicious beasts they ride. These Warg Riders act as scouts for Isengard’s armies, riding in packs to hunt down any who wander the paths around Isengard unprotected. It is these Warg Riders that Saruman sends to run down the Rohirrim on the road as they travel to Helm’s Deep. Base size 25MM Unit Type WARRIOR, CAVALRY Race ORC Faction ISENGARD Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 3 5+ 3 4 1 1 8+ 8+ ISENGARD WARG RIDER...............11 POINTS WARGEAR Armour, hand weapon and Warg. OPTIONS An Isengard Warg Rider must have one of the following options for the listed points cost: Shield and throwing spears...................................................................2 points Orc bow .......................................................................................................1 point Shield ...........................................................................................................1 point Throwing spears ........................................................................................1 point WARGEAR Teeth and claws (hand weapon).

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Base size 25MM Race ORC Faction ISENGARD Unit Type WARRIOR, INFANTRY Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 3 5+ 3 4 1 1 8+ 8+ ISENGARD ORC WARRIOR.............5 POINTS In order to work the machines and pits beneath Isengard, Saruman has bands of Orc Warriors that toil night and day to ensure the fires of industry never cease, each of them marked with the White Hand of Saruman. Much like their counterparts from Mordor, these Orcs are vicious and cruel warriors who will stop at nothing to slay their foes in their master’s name – whether that be the Dark Lord or whichever one of his puppets that he has entrusted his legions to. Base size 25MM Commanding the Isengard Orcs are their captains, the strongest and most canny of their race who serve the White Hand. Though these Orcs are not used as Isengard’s primary fighting force, they are tasked with leading raids on Rohan’s villages and defending the fortress of Isengard from any who would attempt to assail it. It is these captains who lead such raids, commanding their followers to show no mercy to those who stand against the White Wizard. book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Base size 40MM Unit Type WARRIOR, INFANTRY, BEAST, SWARM Faction DUNLAND Race BIRD Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 12" 2 6+ 2 3 2 4 8+ 7+ There are all manner of creatures under the influence of Saruman used as spies by the White Wizard to discover the location of his enemies. Of all such creatures, perhaps the most effective are the Crebain. These large, crow-like birds are native to the lands of Dunland and have been set to patrol the Gap of Rohan during the War of the Ring in search of the Fellowship. Even before the White Wizard’s influence, Crebain were used by the armies of Dunland for much the same reason, spotting beings that were attempting to remain hidden from view. CREBAIN ..................................................................................................20 POINTS WARGEAR Beaks and claws (hand weapon). SPECIAL RULES Fly Keen Sight PASSIVE – Crebain possess exceptionally keen eyesight, allowing them to spot enemies that would normally remain hidden and relay this information to their allies. Enemy models within 12" of this model gain no benefit from the Stalk Unseen special rule. Cloud of Birds PASSIVE – Whilst an individual Crebain may be on the large side by the standards of birds, they are incredibly swift and agile flyers making it almost impossible to hit them with an arrow. Shooting attacks that target a Crebain will only ever hit on the roll of a natural 6.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Race MAN Base size 25MM Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE Faction DUNLAND, ISENGARD 3 1 1 Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 4 4+ 4 4 2 2 6+ 7+ WILD MAN OATHMAKER .............55 POINTS When Saruman called upon the Wild Men of Dunland to join him in his fight against Rohan, it was one of their chieftains that answered the White Wizard’s call. Swearing to fight for Saruman even to the death, this chieftain soon became known as the Oathmaker within the Dunlending armies. Determined to enact their vengeance on the Rohirrim whom they harbour a deep, burning hatred for, the Wild Man Oathmaker will lead the Dunlending tribes with an unbridled fury. WARGEAR Hand weapon. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic Strength SPECIAL RULES Fearless, Hatred (Rohan) Bloodoath PASSIVE – Having sworn in blood to Saruman, the Oathmaker and his Wild Men will fight without fear in the name of the White Hand. Friendly Dunland models within 6" of the Wild Man Oathmaker count as having the Fearless special rule. “We will die for Saruman” PASSIVE – With the lands of Rohan promised to them by Saruman, the Wild Men of Dunland will give their lives to wage war for the Wizard. Whilst Saruman is alive and on the battlefield, the Wild Man Oathmaker and friendly Dunland models must re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: WARGEAR Hand weapon. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic March Base size 25MM Unit Type WARRIOR, INFANTRY Race MAN The Wild Men are outcasts even amongst their own people, living in the most isolated and bleak areas of Dunland. Believing that the Rohirrim have ousted them from the lands they once held, the Wild Men have been reduced to dwelling in scrofulous settlements high within the hills. Here they have had little to do but bitterly lament the lands they have lost, and let their disdain for the Rohirrim fester and grow. This has developed into a burning hatred and the Wild Men will look for any excuse to wage war upon Rohan. Faction DUNLAND Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 3 4+ 3 3 1 1 7+ 8+ WILD MAN OF DUNLAND...............5 POINTS Base size 25MM Race MAN At the head of the rabbles of the Wild Men of Dunland are their chieftains. Such warriors do not hold their rank due to their martial skill or grasp of tactics, for they have little of either. Instead, Wild Men Chieftains are the strongest and most bloodcrazed of their kin, those whose hatred for the Rohirrim runs deepest. It didn’t take much at all for Saruman to convince these chieftains to rouse their bands of Wild Men and take up arms against the kingdom of Rohan and set their houses and fields ablaze. Faction DUNLAND Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY 2 1 1 Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 4 4+ 4 4 2 2 6+ 7+ WILD MAN CHIEFTAIN ........................................................................40 POINTS WARGEAR Hand weapon. Additionally, a model with a Flaming Brand counts as 2 models rather than 1 when working out how many models are within range of an Objective Marker. SPECIAL RULES Hatred (Rohan) OPTIONS Light shield ......................................................................5 points Two-handed weapon.....................................................5 points SPECIAL RULES Hatred (Rohan)

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE Race MAN Base size 25MM 3 3 2 Faction DUNLAND Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 6 3+ 4 5 3 3 5+ 5+ As the son of Freca, who was slain by Helm Hammerhand, Wulf has sworn vengeance upon the King of Rohan and is intent on ending Helm’s bloodline. Having been banished from Rohan following his father’s death, Wulf has since raised an army of Hill Tribesmen, proclaiming himself as the High Lord of the Hill Tribes, and is now prepared to unleash them upon Edoras. Wulf’s burning hatred for the Rohirrim only increases his violence upon the battlefield, viciously slashing and hacking at his foes with seething resentment. WULF, HIGH LORD OF THE HILL TRIBES .........................................110 POINTS WARGEAR Armour and hand weapons. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic Challenge Heroic Strength Heroic Strike OPTIONS Horse ..............................................................................20 points SPECIAL RULES General Hunter, Hatred (Rohan) The Usurper King ACTIVE – Wulf is set on revenge and taking the throne for his own, though to accomplish it he will need to slay the heirs and leaders of Rohan. If Wulf is Engaged in Combat with an enemy Hero, he may re-roll a single D6 during the Duel Roll. Additionally, Wulf must re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes against an enemy Hero.

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Race MAN Base size 25MM Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE Faction DUNLAND 3 2 1 Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 5 4+ 4 6 2 2 6+ 6+ Freca is the Lord of the West-march during the reign of Helm Hammerhand. A hefty and cruel Man of Dunlendish heritage, Freca is known across Rohan for his arrogance and his pride. Freca’s overriding ambition is to secure the throne of Rohan for his son. Daringly, in front of the other Lords of Rohan, Freca demands that Wulf marry Héra; an act that only serves to anger Helm – and results in a brawl outside the hall of Meduseld that leads to Freca’s untimely death. FRECA, LORD OF THE WEST-MARCH ...............................................80 POINTS WARGEAR Heavy armour and hand weapon. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic Challenge Heroic Strength SPECIAL RULES Hatred (Rohan) Dunlending Heritage PASSIVE – Though he is a Lord of Rohan, Freca still has Dunlending blood in his veins and his ancestral people will fight for him should he call upon them. Friendly Dunland Warrior models within 6" of Freca gain a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value. Claim the Throne PASSIVE – Should a path to the throne present itself, Freca will attempt to seize it with both hands, and his followers will fight with redoubled fury. If the enemy General is removed as a casualty whilst within 6" of Freca, then for the duration of the battle friendly Dunland models treat Freca as a banner with a range of 6".

book: Armies of the Lord of the Rings
content: Race MAN Base size 25MM Race MAN Lord Thorne of the Wold is one of the many lords of Rohan under Helm’s rule. An overly extravagant looking nobleman with an ingratiating air, Lord Thorne has long served his liege in times of war and become a trusted advisor. Yet Thorne has great ambition and a lust for power, and it is these flaws that lead him to betray Rohan and join the forces of Wulf. Though he and his Men were meant to protect the east flank of Edoras, Thorne allows Wulf’s armies to pass unhindered and joins them in ransacking Edoras. Base size 25MM Faction ROHAN Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 5 4+ 4 6 2 2 6+ 6+ LORD THORNE OF THE WOLD..........70 POINTS 2 2 2 2 2 1 Calm, collected and skilled in the ways of strategy and warfare, Targg has long been a trusted advisor and so is able to quell the hot-headed nature of the young Wulf and keep him and his forces from being too reckless. One shouldn’t mistake Targg’s skill in tactics for weakness; the general commands his forces with sheer ruthlessness and shares his liege’s disdain for the Rohirrim who drove his Dunlending forebears from their ancestral lands. Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY, UNIQUE Faction DUNLAND Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 5 4+ 4 5 2 2 6+ 4+ GENERAL TARGG...........................80 POINTS HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic Defence Heroic March OPTIONS Horse .......................................................................................................20 points SPECIAL RULES Hatred (Rohan), Master of Battle (4+) Dunlending Commander PASSIVE – General Targg is far more cool-headed than the Hill Tribesmen he commands, and when he is able to keep his followers from recklessly charging in, results are often far more effective. Whilst General Targg is alive and on the battlefield, if you win the roll to choose who has Priority, and choose to give Priority to your opponent, then until the end of the turn friendly Dunland Warrior models within 6" of General Targg may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes. WARGEAR Heavy armour and hand weapon. HEROIC ACTIONS Heroic Challenge SPECIAL RULES Hatred (Rohan) Traitor of Rohan PASSIVE – When Lord Thorne betrays Helm and sides with Wulf, he takes a number of his followers with him to attack Edoras. Lord Thorne may only include Rohirrim Traitors in his Warband. Edoras Shall Fall PASSIVE – Those who have sided with Lord Thorne and attacked Edoras do so with the resolve to see the city razed to the ground. During the Fight Phase, friendly Rohirrim Traitors within 6" of Lord Thorne gain a bonus of +1 to their Fight Value. WARGEAR Armour and hand weapon.

content: Race MAN Base size 25MM Race MAN Faction DUNLAND Unit Type HERO, INFANTRY 1 2 1 Mv Fv Sv S D A W C I 6" 4 4+ 4 4 2 2 6+ 7+ The Hill Tribes around Rohan are each commanded by their own chieftain who leads their people in whichever way they see fit. Ruthless and savage, these chieftains are the strongest in their tribe and will often gain their post through slaying the previous chief in cold blood. When Wulf approached these barbarous Men to join his armies, he promised them the opportunity to extend their lands and raid Rohan for riches, so long as they bent the knee and accepted him as their High Lord – an offer these chieftains readily accepted. Living in fractured communities, the tribesmen have long nurtured a hatred of the Rohirrim and their lands, and have even enacted unorganised and chaotic raids upon the villages of Rohan, though with little success. However, when Wulf manages to rally the tribesmen to his cause, they are able to attack in greater numbers and with an actual battleplan, turning this mindless rabble of dishevelled barbarians into an army capable of threatening even Edoras itself.
